join.note: HyperLEDA's numerical morphological type t for each galaxy, joined by PGC number; empty where HyperLEDA has none. Queried 2026-09-29.

sample: The tracked file keeps the 27,277 of CF4's 55,877 galaxies whose distance modulus puts them between 3 and 200 Mpc (27.386 to 36.505 mag), in PGC order. Nearer, the Local Group catalogue (src/objects/local-group) draws each galaxy; farther, only the SDSS fundamental-plane sample reaches, over part of the northern sky.
meaning: Every galaxy of Cosmicflows-4 (Tully et al. 2023) between 3 and 200 Mpc, each at its measured distance (the distance modulus of all methodologies), coloured by its HyperLEDA morphological type.

endsNm.basis: The Sc template's optical spectrum ends at 766 nm. Cutting the other four templates at 766 nm leaves each colour the same to the sRGB step (checked 2026-09-29), since the eye's response there is under 0.1% of its peak.

missing.label: no type in HyperLEDA
missing.basis: The D65 white point: a galaxy with no measured type is drawn without a colour.

classBasis: Class bounds are the midpoints between the de Vaucouleurs numerical types the templates stand for (E -5, S0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5); types later than Sc take the Sc template, the latest in the atlas.
